headline: Full rig fleet keeps revenue climbing sequentially
summary_short: NorAm Drilling's Q2 2026 revenue was $29.4M, up 12.3% q/q, with adjusted EBITDA of $6.3M, as all 11 rigs stayed contracted and operational at 98.6% fleet utilization.
summary_long: Q2 2026 revenue was $29.4M, up 12.3% q/q, with adjusted EBITDA of $6.3M. All 11 rigs remained under contract and operational all quarter (98.6% fleet utilization). Revenue backlog stood at $30.3M at quarter-end. The company paid a Q2 dividend of $4.9M (NOK 1.08/share). Management noted Permian rig counts rose 17 to 258 during the quarter, driven by private E&Ps, against a volatile WTI backdrop tied to the Iran war; post-quarter WTI strength has brought more rig inquiries, which management believes positions the fleet to benefit from further market recovery. No net profit or EPS figure was disclosed in the release itself.
